violated_contract: The firmware C/C++ Formatting check in Repo Checks must use the same clang-format version as the local pre-commit hook. When the hosted runner image changes its system clang-format, a clean firmware file can fail the hosted check even though pre-commit accepted it.
canonical_prevention: The Formatting job installs clang-format==18.1.8 into a dedicated venv and runs that binary, not the runner's system clang-format. scripts/pre-commit refuses to reformat firmware C unless clang-format 18 is on PATH, so the local and hosted versions match.
